_readme: Example model providers for TrueForge. Ripple never reads keys and never calls a provider; configure these in TrueForge (Settings -> Models, or PUT the manifests with the TrueForge settings API). Copy to config/trueforge.models.json (git-ignored) if you want a local record. Shape follows the ModelProviderManifest type in @truefoundry/trueforge-sdk 0.185.0. All values are placeholders.
